title: Mitigating Risks in Software Development through Effective Requirements Engineering
abstract: arXiv:2305.05800v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Problems that originate in requirements are common and expensive in software projects, and they are a recurring cause of late delivery, budget overruns and cancellation. This paper is a narrative overview of requirements engineering (RE) as a means of reducing these risks. It outlines the core RE activities (elicitation, analysis and negotiation, specification, validation and change management) and the kinds of statements a requirements document contains, including the distinction between requirements, domain properties, assumptions and definitions. It reviews the evidence on the cost of requirements defects, together with the main criticisms of that evidence, and compares how the waterfall, spiral, iterative (Rational Unified Process) and agile lifecycles treat requirements. translated_title: 通过有效的需求工程缓解软件开发中的风险
translated_abstract: 源于需求的问题在软件项目中十分常见且代价高昂，它们是导致交付延期、预算超支和项目取消的一个反复出现的原因。本文是一篇关于需求工程（RE）的叙述性综述，将其视为降低这些风险的一种手段。文章概述了需求工程的核心活动（需求获取、分析与协商、规格说明、验证以及变更管理），以及需求文档中所包含的各类陈述，包括需求、领域属性、假设与定义之间的区别。本文回顾了关于需求缺陷成本的证据以及对这些证据的主要批评，并比较了瀑布式、螺旋式、迭代式（Rational统一过程）和敏捷生命周期对需求的处理方式。随后，文章讨论了利益相关者的识别、需求获取技术以及获取过程中的常见障碍，并描述了将模糊或混淆的陈述（转化为精确需求的实用方法）。
tldr: 本文通过综述需求获取、分析与协商、规格说明、验证和变更管理等核心需求工程活动，并比较不同开发生命周期对需求的处理方式，说明如何利用有效的需求工程来降低软件项目中因需求缺陷导致的延期、超支和项目取消等风险。
en_tdlr: This paper presents a narrative overview of requirements engineering, showing how its core activities—elicitation, analysis and negotiation, specification, validation, and change management—can mitigate the costly risks of late delivery, budget overruns, and project cancellation caused by requirements problems in software development.
